package rulefixtures

import (
	"time"
)

// scenario for time_loadlocation_per_call: `time.LoadLocation(...)` inside request or loop paths instead of reusing the location.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario681Positive(items []string) []time.Time {
	var results []time.Time
	for _, item := range items {
		loc, err := time.LoadLocation("America/New_York")
		if err != nil {
			loc = time.UTC
		}
		_ = item
		results = append(results, time.Now().In(loc))
	}
	return results
}
